targeting_gate.verbatim_anchor:
The present study aimed to elucidate the fac- 
tors influencing natural regeneration of woody 
plants (trees and shrubs) in farmed parklands. 
The research was conducted on-farm and no in- 
terventions (e.g. fencing of areas) were in- 
cluded, in order to avoid influencing the func- 
tioning of the agrosylvopastoral land-use system 
during the 2 year study period.
targeting_gate.rationale: Observational regeneration ecology on existing parklands; valley/moisture associations and seedtree coincidence are findings, not a publication targeting implementation. Recommendations are watering/protection rather than a spatial site-selection rule.
